Spacious 2 bed, 2 bath victorian conversion ground floor flat with a large open plan living room and private garden in the heart of Shepherd's Bush.

This stylish ground-floor apartment features high ceilings, a bright skylit lounge, and bi-fold doors opening to a private garden terrace.

Just minutes from Westfield London with fast connections to Central London.

No chain * Currently used as a Airbnb rental investment

Ideal short let / AirBnb rental property or 1st time buy.
